हुड् हुड्, cl. 6. P. हुडति, &c., to collect,
accumulate, heap together (= rt. हुण्ड्); to
dive, sink, be submerged; cl. 1. P. होडति, &c., to
go (= rts. होड्, हूड्).

हूड् हूड् [cf. rts. ह्रुड्, हुड्, होड्, हौड्,
ह्रौड्], cl. 1. P. (according to Vopa-deva
also A.) हूडति (-ते), जुहूड, &c., हूडितुम्, to
go, move.

हुड, अस्, m. a ram [cf. स-हुड, हुण्ड]; a
kind of fence or bulwark, a bastion, tower; a bar or
iron stake for keeping out thieves; a club, iron club;
(according to some) a place for voiding excrement.

हुडुक्क हुडुक्क, अस्, m. a kind of bird,
Gallinula Madraspatana (= दात्यूह); a drunken
man; a small hourglass-shaped drum; a stick or staff
bound with iron; the bar or bolt of a door.
हुड्डुक, another reading for हुडुक्क above.

हुडुत् हुडुत्, त्, n. (according to Śabda-k.)
the noise of a bull (= वृष-शब्द).

हुडुम्ब हुडुम्ब, अस्, m. a thunder-clap,
(according to Śabda-k. = भ्रष्ट-चिपिट.)
